class _GatherRows(torch.autograd.Function):
    # forward: out[p] = src[perm[p]] if perm[p]>=0 else 0   (perm: padded->src row)
    @staticmethod
    def forward(ctx, src, perm, inv, n_src):
        # src: [n_src, H]; perm: [N_padded] int; 
        idx = perm.clamp_min(0).long()
        out = torch.index_select(src, 0, idx)
        neg = perm < 0
        if neg.any():
            out = out * (~neg).unsqueeze(1).to(out.dtype)  # zero padded rows -- extra pass
        ctx.save_for_backward(inv)
        ctx.n_src = n_src
        return out
    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx, grad_out):
        inv, = ctx.saved_tensors
        # grad_src[t] = grad_out[inv[t]] if inv[t]>=0 else 0  -- gather
        idx = inv.clamp_min(0).long()
        grad_src = torch.index_select(grad_out, 0, idx)
        neg = inv < 0
        if neg.any():
            grad_src = grad_src * (~neg).unsqueeze(1).to(grad_out.dtype)
        return grad_src, None, None, None
```

class _Gather(torch.autograd.Function):
    @staticmethod
    def forward(ctx, src, map_idx):  # map_idx: int64 [N], -1 => zero row
        idx = map_idx.clamp_min(0)
        out = torch.index_select(src, 0, idx)
        mask = (map_idx >= 0).unsqueeze(1)
        out = out * mask.to(out.dtype)   # zero the -1 rows
        ctx.save_for_backward(map_idx)
        ctx.n_src = src.shape[0]
        return out
    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx, grad_out):
        map_idx, = ctx.saved_tensors
        # grad_src[t] = sum_{p: map_idx[p]==t} grad_out[p]; unique => index_copy_
        grad_src = grad_out.new_zeros((ctx.n_src, grad_out.shape[1]))
        valid = map_idx >= 0
        idx = map_idx[valid]
        src_rows = grad_out[valid]   # boolean mask gather
        grad_src.index_copy_(0, idx, src_rows)  # non-atomic scatter (unique)
        return grad_src, None
```
